name: Reka Flash 3
title: Reka Flash 3: price, context window and specs
answer: Reka Flash 3 is a model in Rekaai's Rekaai Reka family, first listed on 2025-03-12. It takes text in and returns text, with a context window of 65K tokens and up to 58K tokens of output. On the lowest-cost route in the OpenRouter catalog it costs $0.1 per million input tokens and $0.2 per million output tokens. It supports a reasoning mode, where the model works through a problem before it answers. Its weights are published on Hugging Face as RekaAI/reka-flash-3, so it can be run on your own hardware as well as through a provider. Its training data runs to 2025-01-31.
compare: It is the oldest of the 2 versions of Rekaai Reka still listed.
Its input price is the family median, $0.1 per million tokens.
No version in the family has a larger context window.
